title: A sparse spectral method on a class of domains bounded by planar algebraic curves
summary: We develop a sparse spectral method for solving partial differential equations on a class of two-dimensional geometries bounded by algebraic curves. The numerical method uses generalised bivariate Koornwinder polynomials which form a complete orthogonal basis, but one which is not graded in terms of polynomial degree. The polynomials are built from new families of univariate semiclassical orthogonal polynomials whose associated operator matrices (Jacobi matrices, raising matrices and differentiation matrices) are computed with optimal linear complexity in the number of basis functions.
